subject: Money
title: Canadian Housing Market
description: A 60-second lesson on Canadian Housing Market.

hook.text: The average home in Toronto costs $1.1 million. The average household income is $84,000. The math doesn't work.

buildup.text: Canada's housing prices rose 300% since 2000, driven by low rates, immigration, and limited supply.

discovery.text: Canadian household debt is 180% of income—highest in the G7. Much of it is mortgage debt.

twist.text: When the Bank of Canada raised rates in 2022, variable-rate mortgage holders saw payments jump 40% overnight.

climax.text: Whether Canada experiences a crash or a slow correction, an entire generation is priced out of ownership.

punchline.text: A house shouldn't take a lifetime to afford.

quiz.question: What makes Canada's housing market fragile?
options: Household debt at 180% of income, mostly mortgages
